key_insight: The paper turns RL policy explanations into measurable symbolic rules, using ILP to quantify how understandable and behavior-aligned an agent’s decisions are.
engineering_relevance: This gives engineers a practical way to audit, compare, and transfer RL policies in safety-critical or multi-agent systems with objective explainability metrics.
method: Use Inductive Logic Programming to extract symbolic rules from RL policies.
Measure explainability with activation rate, feature coverage, syntactic distance, and semantic distance.
Track policy evolution across training, agents, and multi-agent coordination settings.
evidence_signal: Experiments across multiple RL domains show the metrics reveal action-specific learning dynamics, feature-level insights, and coordination/specialization patterns beyond global return.
watch_item: Interpretability depends on the quality of the ILP-generated rules, so weak or incomplete symbolic extractions may limit metric reliability.
paper_title: Explaining Reinforcement Learning Agents via Inductive Logic Programming
